sloka: तत्तस्य रक्तं रक्तेन ऽञ्जितं शुशुभे मुखम् ।यथा ऽ ऽकाशे महापद्मं सिक्तं चन्दनबिन्दुभिः ।। ५.४४.९।।।।
transliteration: tattasya raktaṁ raktena 'ñjitaṁ śuśubhe mukham ।yathā ' 'kāśe mahāpadmaṁ siktaṁ candanabindubhiḥ ।। 5.44.9।।।।

translations.english: His red face stained with blood was glowing bright like red lotus in the sky sprinkled with drops of red sandal.
